overview_description.description: PowerUp Money is a financial technology firm that provides a digital platform for mutual fund investment advisory and portfolio management. It offers tools that let users review, select, and rebalance mutual fund portfolios through a mobile application, along with personalized investment guidance services. The company’s platform supports a subscription-based advisory tier as well as tools aimed at helping individuals plan and manage their financial goals. PowerUp Money also integrates features for financial insights and goal-oriented planning to support self-directed investing. Its services are designed to help individuals evaluate and manage their investment options within a single digital interface.

about_short_description.short_description: PowerUp Money is a financial technology firm that provides a digital platform for mutual fund investment advisory and portfolio management.

product.name: Power Mutual Funds
product.description: A digital mutual fund advisory and portfolio-tracking platform for researching funds, monitoring performance, reviewing holdings, and identifying portfolio actions such as starting, pausing, or exiting SIPs.

product.name: PowerUp Elite
product.description: A paid mutual fund advisory membership that provides proprietary fund rankings, portfolio reviews, fund comparisons, and personalized rebalancing guidance for retail investors.

identifier.value: Mutual Fund Investment Advisory and Portfolio Management

product.name: Mutual Fund Investment Advisory and Portfolio Management
product.description: SEBI-registered investment advisory services that help investors select, review, and rebalance mutual fund portfolios using data-driven recommendations aligned with their goals and risk preferences.

product.name: Financial Education and Investment Calculators
product.description: Educational content and online calculators that help users understand investing concepts and estimate outcomes for SIPs, lump-sum investments, CAGR, loans, EMIs, and home affordability.
